audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored for Vayne in both layers (phases[4].side, win[4]) while whys[4], spikes[1] and mid all say Cannon Barrage zones her and sets up a dive; and 2+ items was scored for Gangplank (phases[6].side, win[6]) while whys[6] and spikes[3] say she out-scales hard.
audit.why: 56.76% over 1369 games is a Gangplank-favoured lane that inverts at two items. The packet levelChart (Vayne, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Vayne) matches the prose; the sides did not.
audit.corrected: phases[4]/win[4] to Gangplank, phases[6]/win[6] to Vayne, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Final Hour is never described anywhere in the matchup — no spike, phase or don't mentions it.
audit.why: Riot's text: Final Hour grants 'Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown' on a 100/85/70 cooldown. That is the single reason a Vayne survives your level-6 dive and re-enters a fight you thought you had won, and it was entirely absent.
audit.corrected: Final Hour's invisible Tumbles written into phases[4].why, spikes[3] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were checked and missing: (a) Tumble is an auto-attack reset, so the tell is the wind-up not the cast; (b) Condemn only stuns if the knockback collides with terrain — in open lane it is a pure displacement.
audit.why: Both change what you do. (a) means you step back on her wind-up; (b) means you take the fight away from walls and her stun is worth nothing.
audit.corrected: Reset tell added to phases[0].why; terrain condition added to dosFull[2].d. Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage flagged as armour-proof in dontsFull[1].d.
sources: enemyKit Q autoReset flag and text
enemyKit E text 'If they collide with terrain'

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Vayne 'he' throughout (tradeGood, tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, feeding) and the don'ts details do not match their own titles — 'Fight her at 2 items' was explained with a line about burning a cooldown for tiny value.
audit.why: Boilerplate carried over from another matchup; the detail lines taught nothing about Vayne.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and each don't's detail rewritten to match its title.

edits.before: Barrel-poke her early — Q-cleanse her, all-in early. Gangplank wins the Condemn cooldown windows.
edits.after: Barrel-poke her early and all-in before two items. Final Hour hides her Tumble — kill her before then.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Tumble is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. She free-pops fresh kegs; don't place them yet.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage zones her off the wave and sets a dive — Tumble (2s at rank 5) is her only escape. Final Hour hides her tumbles, so ward.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and she flips it: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores your armour and Condemn wall-stuns your keg chains.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Vayne steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Vayne steps to farm, and Remove Scurvy the chip she answers with.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Letting her shoot fresh kegs — a low-HP barrel dies to one auto and hands her the lane for free.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Condemn stuns only into terrain — fight open lane, not walls.

edits.before: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Vayne's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' third hit is percent-HP true damage; armour won't help.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Free farm gets her to two items, where her true damage and kiting beat you outright — deny the wave.

edits.before: Vayne's threat window. Silver Bolts (W) percent-max-HP true damage plus Condemn (E) stunning you against a wall let her kite your kegs and out-DPS you no matter how tanky you build.
edits.after: Vayne's threat window. Silver Bolts (W) percent-max-HP true damage, Condemn (E) stunning you against a wall, and Final Hour's invisible Tumbles let her kite your kegs and out-DPS you however tanky you build.

edits.before: Be honest with yourself: Vayne reclaims the game if it goes long. Her Silver Bolts (W) deal percent-max-HP true damage that shreds you no matter how tanky you build, and her Condemn (E) knocks you into a wall for a stun the moment you try to chain kegs on her. Make the late game never matter — snowball your first-item lead, take towers and grubs with Cannon Barrage (R), and end before she has two items. If a fight breaks out at 3 items, don't dive her: let your team peel and use your global R to apply pressure in another part of the map.
edits.after: Be honest with yourself: Vayne reclaims the game if it goes long. Her Silver Bolts (W) deal percent-max-HP true damage that shreds you no matter how tanky you build, her Condemn (E) wall-stuns your keg chain, and Final Hour (R, 100s at rank 1) makes every Tumble invisible so she re-enters a fight you thought you won. Make the late game never matter — snowball your first-item lead, take towers and grubs with Cannon Barrage (R), and end before she has two items. If a fight breaks out at 3 items, don't dive her: peel with your team and use your global R elsewhere on the map.
